The MAP overview describes an at-least-biennial review of governance, taxpayer assistance, operating procedures, and appraisal standards, procedures and methodology.
The 2025 results inventory lists Reeves and states that 2025-reviewed districts have until January 2027 to complete recommendations.
The Reeves report records PASS on all four mandatory requirements and review-area scores of 100, 92, 100, and 96.

The two No answers and recommendations are question 29 on the Tax Code 11.43(q) cancellation procedure for certain over-65 residence homestead exemptions and question 74 on rendition-penalty notice delivery.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Methods and Assistance Program overview (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official MAP overview supplies the biennial review purpose, four review areas, PTAD role, and tier context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The overview does not establish a Reeves property fact, mineral-account result, ownership, appraisal correctness, tax, protest, private value, offer, or transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller 2025 MAP Review Results (accessed 2026-08-31)

sources_inspected.claim_scope: The inventory is routing and deadline context only; it does not establish that a particular recommendation is complete or apply a report finding to any property.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Reeves County Appraisal District 2025 Final MAP Report (accessed 2026-08-31)

sources_inspected.claim_scope: The report reviews district operations and does not identify or determine a mineral account, title, ownership, classification, property appraisal, ratio outcome, tax bill, protest result, private value, offer, or transaction.
